name: dfmt-dlang
description: Format D source files with the dfmt formatter. Standalone: no D language server or other D extension required.

dfmt.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `dfmt` executable. The default `dfmt` is resolved through the system `PATH`, so no change is needed when dfmt is installed normally. Set an absolute path (for example `C:\dlangdevtools\dfmt.exe`) if dfmt is not on the `PATH`. Surrounding double quotes are ignored, and the path may contain spaces.

dfmt.arguments.markdownDescription: Extra command-line arguments passed to dfmt on every invocation, for example `--single_indent=true` or `--max_line_length=100`. Run `dfmt --help` for the full list of options. Arguments take precedence over `.editorconfig` and over dfmt's built-in defaults.

dfmt.useEditorConfig.markdownDescription: Run dfmt from the folder that contains the document so that the project's `.editorconfig` file is applied, matching what `dfmt` does when it is run on a file from the command line. Disable this to always use dfmt's built-in defaults plus `dfmt.arguments`.
